subject.title: [Feature]: Discord - auto-inject @mention for guild message replies

question: Should Discord add an opt-in outbound policy that injects the original guild reply author's visible `<@id>` mention, and what config shape/default should own it?
rationale: The remaining work is not a broken existing contract: it adds new notification behavior and config surface that may ping users differently from today's reply/reference and mentionAliases behavior.

options.title: Approve a narrow opt-in policy
options.body: Design a Discord plugin config with default-off behavior and tests for guild replies, DMs, existing mentions, broadcasts, bot-authored messages, and chunking.

options.title: Rely on existing mention surfaces
options.body: Close or defer this request and continue using Discord native replies plus `mentionAliases` for deterministic visible mentions.

options.title: Fold into broader Discord routing work
options.body: Treat this as part of a larger Discord mention/reply routing policy with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/13487 instead of adding a standalone option.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow opt-in policy
recommendation.body: Design a Discord plugin config with default-off behavior and tests for guild replies, DMs, existing mentions, broadcasts, bot-authored messages, and chunking.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-main history on the Discord delivery code and config-sensitive review surface.
